headline: Rate-case recoveries lift growth, guidance affirmed
summary_short: American Water Works reported Q2 FY2026 diluted EPS of $1.61 (+61.0% q/q, +8.8% y/y) on revenue of $1,355M (+12.3% q/q, +6.2% y/y) and net income of $315M (+60.7% q/q, +9.0% y/y), with 2026 adjusted EPS guidance of $6.02-$6.12 affirmed.
summary_long: Revenue of $1,355M rose 12.3% q/q and 6.2% y/y, driven by new rate implementation from completed general rate cases and infrastructure surcharges plus acquisition-driven customer growth (~52,000 connections added YTD), partially offset by higher production/power/chemicals costs and depreciation. Regulated Businesses net income rose to $331M from $288M y/y. Operating income of $542M (+10.8% y/y) outpaced opex growth; pretax income growth was tempered by $11M higher interest expense funding the $3.7B 2026 capital plan. Diluted EPS of $1.61 (+8.8% y/y) as shares outstanding were roughly flat. The company affirmed FY2026 adjusted EPS guidance of $6.02-$6.12 and long-term 7-9% EPS/dividend growth targets, declared a $0.8950/share quarterly dividend, and reported continued progress on the pending Essential Utilities merger (three states approved).

drivers.explanation: New rates from completed general rate cases and infrastructure surcharges, plus incremental revenue from closed acquisitions, added $90M q/q; partially offset by higher operating costs and depreciation.
Revenue growth of $90M outpaced the $29M rise in operating expenses (higher purchased water, power, chemicals costs, and $21M more depreciation from capital investment growth).
Regulated Businesses net income rose to $331M from $288M on rate-case recoveries and acquisitions, partly offset by $11M higher interest expense from incremental debt funding capex.
Higher operating income was partly offset by $11M more interest expense from incremental short- and long-term debt used to fund the $3.7B 2026 capital investment plan.
Tracks net income growth; diluted weighted-average shares rose only 0.5% q/q and y/y, so per-share growth closely mirrors the net income increase.
Includes $476M net proceeds from physically settling 3.4M shares under existing forward sale agreements in June 2026, plus retained earnings growth.

Company affirmed FY2026 adjusted EPS guidance of $6.02-$6.12 and 7-9% long-term EPS/dividend growth targets; cited a constructive PA rate decision and Essential Utilities merger-integration progress (three states approved, Texas settlement in principle).
